subtitle: Lesson 8 · A Second, Separate Root Cause

steps.label: Billing's problem
steps.sub: One query, running slow on its own

steps.label: Scheduling's problem
steps.sub: Sessions stalling mid-request, waiting on another session

code:
SELECT r.session_id, r.wait_type, r.wait_time,
       r.blocking_session_id, s.program_name
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s ON r.session_id = s.session_id
WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0;
caption: Several scheduling sessions, all waiting on the same one session.

eyebrow: What the head of the chain is doing
code:
UPDATE dbo.Appointments
SET Status = 'Confirmed'
WHERE AppointmentDate = @Today AND Status = 'Pending';
-- no COMMIT yet -- waits on confirmation messages to finish
caption: An open transaction holding locks on dbo.Appointments the whole time.

subtitle: Shortening the transaction that's holding everyone up.
